title: Check: Surface Area of Cones and Spheres

questions.stem: A hemisphere has a radius of $6\text{ cm}$. What is its total surface area (curved surface plus flat circular base) in terms of $\pi$?
questions.explanation: Curved surface of hemisphere $= 2\pi r^2 = 2\pi(36) = 72\pi\text{ cm}^2$. Flat base $= \pi r^2 = 36\pi\text{ cm}^2$. Total $= 72\pi + 36\pi = 108\pi\text{ cm}^2$.
